derivedFrom: 22.13's trade worked by hand over constructed prices, not a run. Eight S&P 400 members, I01 to I08, close at 100 plus their number on 26 October 2026, open a dollar above that close on 27 October and close two above it, and close four above it on 28 October, but I01, which falls to 100; I08 holds no bar on 27 October. I01's filing, first filed on 23 October, is read for the first time on 26 October at 8 of 9 with its sales growing faster, so it is chosen at 101 and bought at 102, a gap of 1 / 101. On 28 October its score stands at 6 of 9, under the hold of 7, so it is sold at that close, 100: its growth 100 / 101 less one less its gap, -2 / 101. Its benchmark is the members answered on 26 October, each its growth to 28 October, I01's 100 / 101, (104 + n) / (100 + n) for I02 to I07 and I08's 112 / 108 from its answer of 26 October, their mean 1.0321078, less one less the mean gap at the open of the seven holding one, 1 / (100 + n) for n of 1 to 7, 0.0096189: 0.0224889. Its round trip is half the published spread of a company over $2 billion at a price over $40, 0.072 per cent, paid at 102 and at 100 over 102: 0.0712941 per cent. Its edge is -2 / 101 less 0.0224889, in points, less 0.0712941: -4.3003789.
